mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(id) FROM edudoc_collab_session WHERE document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) ORDER BY create_time DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_collab_session (id, document_id, base_version_id, provider_doc_key, status, created_by) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{idHex}), HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{baseVersionIdHex}), #{providerDocKey}, 'OPEN', HEXTORAW(#{createdByHex}))
mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(m.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(m.user_id) AS userId, u.username AS username, u.display_name AS displayName, m.permission_level AS permission, m.connection_status AS connectionStatus, m.joined_at AS joinedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_collab_member m JOIN edudoc_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.collab_session_id = HEXTORAW(#{sessionIdHex}) AND m.connection_status <> 'REMOVED' ORDER BY m.joined_at
SELECT FROM edudoc_collab_member m JOIN edudoc_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.collab_session_id = HEXTORAW(#{sessionIdHex}) AND m.user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_collab_member m JOIN edudoc_collab_session s ON s.id = m.collab_session_id WHERE s.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) AND m.user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND m.connection_status <> 'REMOVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_collab_member (id, collab_session_id, user_id, permission_level, connection_status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{idHex}), HEXTORAW(#{sessionIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}), #{permissionLevel}, 'OFFLINE')
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_collab_member SET permission_level = #{permissionLevel}, connection_status = 'OFFLINE', left_at = NULL WHERE collab_session_id = HEXTORAW(#{sessionIdHex}) AND user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND connection_status = 'REMOVED'

UPDATE edudoc_collab_member SET connection_status = 'REMOVED', left_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE collab_session_id = HEXTORAW(#{sessionIdHex}) AND user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND connection_status <> 'REMOVED'
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(id) AS userId, username AS username, display_name AS displayName FROM edudoc_user WHERE username = #{username}
